csv_scope_of_work: Columbia County is seeking a qualified consultant to provide Preliminary Engineering Design for the 2025 Bridge Rail Safety Project. Four (4) existing County bridges require safety upgrades to their current guardrail systems. The current proposed improvements include the removal and/or modification of existing bridge guardrail(s) to bring the traffic barrier systems up to current safety standards. The major features of the project are as follows: Structural design to Remove/retrofit/install bridge rail and approach guardrail at: Lower Hogeye Road from MP 5.75-5.83; Gallaher Road from MP 0.36-0.44; Whetstone Road from MP 4.98-5.04; Whetstone Road from MP 6.56-6.62. Columbia County reserves the right to retain the services of the successful firm(s) for any subsequent phases (R/W, PS&E, CE, CN, Surveying, & Materials Testing) associated with this project
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Materials Testing, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
